Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools) Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation. An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help. jobs.description: Job Description Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Rigorous testing is what turns a promising prototype into a product our customers can trust – and what gets us from validated prototype to Alpha customer readiness to volume shipments. As Test Engineer, you will design and execute test plans for our power conversion systems – from functional and target-parameter verification through stability, endurance and load testing. You will build and maintain the test setups that validate our hardware and firmware, and work closely with Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical engineers to track down and resolve issues. It is a unique opportunity to shape the test strategy of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership. Key Responsibilities • Design and execute test plans for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems – functional tests, stability tests, endurance (soak) tests, and load tests. • Build and maintain test setups for prototype, pilot and production units, including medium-voltage test benches. • Support prototype validation and target-parameter verification (form factor, efficiency, stability) for our Prototype milestone. • Support qualification testing for Alpha customer deployments – full target-parameter verification, certification test support, and release tests for volume delivery. • Develop test automation scripts and tools to increase test coverage and reduce manual test effort. • Collaborate with the Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical teams to diagnose and root-cause test failures. • Document test procedures, results and reports; maintain traceability for certification and quality purposes. • Support the definition and specification of end-of-line (EOL) test equipment for volume production, working with our EOL test equipment vendor. • Support field testing and diagnostics for units deployed at customer sites as needed. Qualifications • BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, electronics engineer (Elektroniker EFZ), automation engineer (Automatiker EFZ) or comparable education. • 3+ years of experience in test engineering, ideally for power electronics or medium-voltage systems. • Experience with medium-voltage high-power test setups and lab safety protocols and practices. • Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar). • Understanding of power electronics test methods (efficiency, thermal, load and stability testing). • Strong documentation and analytical skills. • Team player, comfortable working hands-on in the lab with cross-functional teams. • Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory. • The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Benefits • Equity + competitive salary. • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments. • Hybrid work with flexible working times. jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap; Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto ; Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike; Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied

jobs.title: Automation Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program. You will play a central role in designing, programming and operating automation cells performing a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating. You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians WHAT YOU WILL DO Advise on future line design and automation concepts Define the requirements for automation cells for different processes to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation Contribute to the development of control strategies for new production lines You will build and commission automation cells, including running FAT at supplier sites Identify and test different manufacturing and in-process monitoring approaches Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production Support in the process development and prototyping of magnets, with scalability and repeatability in mind. Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams WHO YOU ARE A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field A wide experience in robotics, automation and process monitoring in an industrial setting Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding) Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming (e.g. RoboGuide, RobotStudio, Process Simulate). jobs.description: Growth at Private Equity Insights The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights. The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel. If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply. Why Private Equity Insights Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more. Private Equity Insights is part of United Media ( https://www.united-media.com/ ) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1. What we offer you Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act. Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts. Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale. Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way. Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences. What you will do Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following: Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many. Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI. Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move. Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last. Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers. What we expect from you 1 to 3 years of experience Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas. Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise Practical details Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description: About Freetrade Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings. We’re changing that. We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in. 2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space. This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers. About the role As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer. What you’ll do Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps Be instrumental in the implementation of mobile tests that support the CI/CD pipeline for the software stacks and frameworks we support (TS, XCode, WebdriverIO) Work with the Staff QE to ensure the rollout and socialisation of proactive quality information, plans and reports to project teams, enabling them to make better decisions around processes, solutions and releases Advocate for, coach and educate project teams on the contextual use of testing techniques that allow us to embed shift-left and shift-right testing practices Bring a quality lens to ideas before they’re built, working with engineers, product and design (e.g. Three Amigos) Work comfortably in ambiguity: find gaps, chase down requirements and take initiative without being spoon-fed Contribute to upcoming projects, including acceptance testing to support the backend re-architecture and our quality strategy refresh Use AI tools to move faster and go broader, with appropriate guardrails to keep quality high About You Hands-on experience testing iOS and Android apps, and adding tests to an existing automation framework (we use TypeScript; familiarity helps and tool agnosticism is welcome) A blend of manual and automated testing, with breadth across testing types (functional, acceptance and exploratory, with non-functional a bonus) and the judgement to know which to use when You’ve owned testing and built things, such as a framework, automation or a test process your team adopted Strong written and verbal communication (fluent English) and influencing skills, comfortable sharing test plans and reports and advising engineers, product owners and project managers A self-starter who is comfortable with uncertainty, curious, and looks for gaps and negative cases Pragmatic: you know what “good enough” looks like and help teams ship Experience in exploratory testing and/or requirements discovery Strong independent testing skills and opinions, and a curious but pragmatic view of AI We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you. To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here. Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.
